ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixels (approx. 92%) with localized high-intensity (white/tan) clusters (approx. 8%) creating a high contrast ratio in focal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark uniform field (low-intensity) with high-intensity circular clusters concentrated on the leading edges and distal tips; sparse high-intensity focal points scattered throughout the central and lower lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 52-degree pixel angle relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge, consisting of irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-depth variations ranging from 4 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep on the trailing edge terminating in narrow distal tips; leading edge presents a broad convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast circular clusters (rosettes) primarily along the leading edges and lobe tips; several faint circular depigmentation spots are present on the inner lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible on the medial-left and lower-right regions of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent three-dimensional textured clusters (barnacle colonies) on distal tips; multiple circular depigmented scars visible across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy, bulbous barnacle colonization forming distinct 'caps' at the extreme lateral distal points of both fluke lobes.
